scorecard.venue: Rajiv Gandhi International Stadium, Uppal, Hyderabad

batting.name: R Ravindra
batting.dismissal: c AK Markram b B Kumar

batting.name: RD Gaikwad
batting.dismissal: c Abdul Samad b Shahbaz Ahmed

batting.name: AM Rahane
batting.dismissal: c M Markande b JD Unadkat

batting.name: S Dube
batting.dismissal: c B Kumar b PJ Cummins

batting.name: DJ Mitchell
batting.dismissal: c Abdul Samad b T Natarajan

batting.name: TM Head
batting.dismissal: c R Ravindra b M Theekshana

batting.name: Abhishek Sharma
batting.dismissal: c RA Jadeja b DL Chahar

balls.text: Can Jadeja get a boundary off the last ball. He can't. Oh, dear, Unadkat has messed it up at deep backward square leg. Low full toss on his pads, he flicks it straight to Unadkat, who over-runs and concedes three extra runs
Banged in short, was the slower ball again and he can only mistime his pull to deep backward square leg
Can't lay a bat first up. Was a slower back of a length ball angling across Dhoni. He wafts at it and misses
Straight to long-on! Fuller on the stumps, he gets under the ball but does not get the elevation. Long-on takes a simple catch
Banged in short, at shoulder-high, he swivel-pulls to deep backward square leg
Back of a length ball well outside off, he mistimes it again towards extra cover
Absolutely on the point with the yorker to Mitchell on off. He can only dig it out to long on
Fuller outside off, he can only mistime this to long off

Pinpoint yorker on the stumps, he digs it back to the bowler who fires in a throw back at the stumps. And instead hits Jadeja who was way out his crease. Ooh, is there an appeal for obstruction? Don't think there is an appeal. The   bowler walked back immediately. But the umpires converge. Cummins says he does not want them to go up
Another offpace delivery at 112kph on a length outside off. He mistimes his thrash to extra cover.
Excellent yorker on off stump, he digs it out somehow to long on. A good flat throw comes in but Mitchell was well in
Slower offcutter bowled on a length well outside off. He thrashes it to deep point

Does he find the gap? Oh, he does. The over started with a four, and ends with a four. Slower bouncer around shoulder high at 118kph. He waits for the ball, swivels and pulls it to the right of deep backward square leg
Slower offcutter now at 112kph outside off, he slaps it to deep point only for a run though
Pace on again at 139kph on a length on off stump. He drags it to long-on
And now goes at 143kph. Low full toss on the stumps. Jadeja was late his stroke and gets a thick inside edge through his legs to short fine leg
Slower offcutter outside off, he slaps it towards cover. The fielder gets across from extra cover but a misfield allows an extra run
Slower bouncer at 117kph but the line was key. Was bowled well outside off giving Jadeja the room. He thrashes it over point for four
Slower bouncer at 110kph as he pulls to deep backward square leg

Unadkat is giving them absolutely no pace to work with. Manufacture whatever pace you can he says. Was the slower bouncer again on middle, Jadeja gets inside the line of it, but still can only pull to short fine leg
Very slow bouncer well outside off. Mitchell waits and waits before finally thrashing him meekly to deep point
Slower offcutter at 104kph deceives Mitchell all ends up. He was looking to tee off again, can only mistime back to the bowler
Slower offcutter well outside off, Jadeja gets right across but the pace of the ball means he can only guide it to short third
Low full toss on Jadeja's pads. He gets across and helps it neatly past short fine leg for a much-needed four
Banged in short at shoulder-high, he pulls it down towards deep midwicket for a run
124.1 back of a length ball on middle and leg, he gets across and slaps it to deep backward square leg
Cummins gets a good hand at extra cover and probably saves three. Was a low full toss outside off. Jadeja drives crisply, but can't beat Cummins
Back of a length ball angling across Mitchell who stands tall and punches to deep cover
Slower bouncer outside off, he swivels and pulls to deep midwicket
On a length at 128.4kph outside off. He looks to dab it down to deep third, misses

Taken by backward point and Unadkat ends Rahane's misery. Slower offcutter bowled at 105kph outside off. Was fuller in length as Rahane looked to go over cover. Gets it off the cue end of the bat and Markande takes a good catch behind him
Slower back of a length ball on middle stump, shoulder-high as he gets across and pulls to deep backward square leg
Length on middle and leg, he drags it to midwicket
Lovely shot! Banged in short outside off. Was a slower ball again at 111kph. Jadeja dances down the track, and had to reach for the ball. Ends up playing a forehand past mid-off
Slower offcutter on off stump bowled at 108.7kph. Rahane mistimes his loft to long-on
Pacy length ball on off stump at 126kph,  he pushes to mid-off for a quick run
Slower back of a length ball on middle, he swivel-pulls to deep midwicket for a run
Low full toss just outside off, he can only push it to backward point

Soft dismissal and captain Cummins has the big fish! Slower bouncer outside off. He stays legside of the ball, deceived by the pace of the ball. He can only bunt it to backward point who takes the easiest of catches
On a length on off stump, he slogs it away to deep backward square leg for a run
Slower offcutter on middle and leg stump, he works it to deep backward square leg for a couple of runs
Excellent on-pace yorker on middle and leg stump. Dube somehow digs it out to long-on
Lovely square drive and even better running. Was a pacy length ball outside off. He opens the face of the bat and drives to the right of deep point
Banged in short, was the slower bouncer. Dube waits for it for an eternity and then slaps it to long-off
On-pace good length ball outside off, chips it to long-on
Juuuuust out of reach of a flying Pat Cummins at mid-off. Slower offcutter on leg stump, he lofts it a little cleaner this time and gets enough bat to clear mid-off
Back of a length ball on off stump, he backs away and  mistimes to mid-off
Completely shanks the attempted hack, and that probably saves Rahane. Was a back of a length ball on off stump. He was looking to go over long-on, miscues it towards Markram at wide long-on
Pinpoint yorker on off stump. Dube can only dig it back towards the bowler
Excellent yorker on off stump, but he still manages to squeeze it out to deep cover for a couple of runs
Slower back of a length ball outside off, this time he can only bunt it to point
Two in two for Dube! Natarajan goes fuller but it makes no difference to Dube. He clears his front leg and hammers the ball on leg stumps over deep midwicket once more
BELTED! First boundary after 14 balls. Was a back of a length ball that sat up nicely for Dube. He swivels and pulls miles over deep midwicket
Straight up but the ball falls in no-man's land. Natarajan gets the back of a length ball into Rahane and hurries him. His attempted pull balloons up and falls short of deep third
Slower bouncer but he follows Rahane, who was backing away. The batter can only pull it down to deep backward square leg
Dube does pack a punch even for singles. Back of a length ball outside off, he absolutely smokes it to long off
Similar pacy good length ball on middle. Rahane is beaten again on the pull as an appeal ensues. The ball was going over, though
On pace good length ball that beats Rahane's attempted pull and crashes into his thigh pad. The ball was probably going down leg
Slower bouncer that deceives Rahane. But that was high enough to be called a wide
Skews it but gets enough bat to beat backward point. Was a fuller slower ball on off. He backs away looking to go over cover. Gets a bit of a leading edge towards deep third
Back of a length ball outside off, he gets across and works it but can't beat square leg

Oh, what a save by Nitish Reddy. He's saved four for his team. Back of a length ball outside off, Dube backs away and thrashes it to Reddy's left. He flings to his left, with both hands and saves important runs
Good fielding by Unadkat at the deep third fence. Was a rising back of a length ball outside off. Rahane throws his hands at it with an open face of the bat but Unadkat does brilliantly
Slower bouncer outside off, he is deceived by it and can only mistime towards point
Gives Cummins the charge but does get a good enough connection on it. Was the length ball on off stump. He gives himself room and skews it over backward point
Fuller in length on middle and leg, he works it to midwicket
Slower length ball on off stump, Dube can only defend it to the bowler
Shorter and wider, Dube goes back and slaps the ball hard but straight to deep extra cover
Over deep backward square leg fielder's head. Dube has raced away to 24 off 9. Was fuller down leg, he gets down on one knee and thumps him into the stands
Length on off, he hangs back and turns over the strike to long on
Similar length on middle and leg, he works it to deep square leg, this time a touch firmer
Flatter on middle stump, he goes back and works it to deep square leg with soft hands. Gets two to his name
Short and wide, Dube hangs back and cuts it between the fielder at backward point and cover point. No one is deep there on the off side.
Keeps the trajectory flatter and the line away from Dube's hitting arc outside off. He stays back and bashes him hard but straight to long-on
Gives him room and Dube cashes in. Fuller and a flatter well outside off. Dube absolutely hammers him over the cover fielder. No one moves.
Takes him three balls but Dube gets a six. Length outside off, he gets down on one knee, under the ball and goes straight over the bowler's head for a huge six
Flatter outside off, he looks for a cut, but fails to get  a connection
He was lining him up. Was a length ball flatter outside off, he drives to extra cover. Rahane eyes the single but is sent back

And gets a wicket first ball. Gaikwad saw his chance to score some runs but failed in the execution. Was a gentle length ball on middle stump. The CSK captain tries to get under the ball, fails to do it and as a result does not get  a decent connection. The ball finds the inside half of the blade and long-on takes a simple catch
Flatter again at 86kph on off and middle, he hops back and slaps the length ball to long-on
A touch quicker again at 88.6kph outside off. He opens the face of the bat and gets it to deep point
A touch quicker on middle and leg, he stays back and punches to long on
Slower through the air but the line on the leggie was on the pads. He flicks it to deep backward square leg
Tossed up on off, he shimmies down and drives to the right of extra cover
Flatter legspinner to start off on middle and leg, he pushes to long on

Shot of the night so far. Will this be topped? Was a length ball on off stump. He prods forward, one step down, presents the full face of the bat and lofts the ball straight over the bowler's head. Goes all the way
Another knuckle ball outside off, he plays with an open face but straight to backward point
Aerial but in the gap. Was the knuckle ball outside off. He opens the face of the blade and helps it fine, a little too fine for his comfort but placed it just wide of short third
Gets a lovely cover drive going his way but for no run. Was fuller in length just outside off, he laces the drive but can't beat the fielder
Slower length ball just outside off, he pushes it towards backward point with soft hands. Easier single this time around
Picked up and how! Nothing wrong with the length or line but Rahane is in some form. Was a good length ball on off, he stays still, raises his elbow and lifts it over mid-on.
On a length on off stump, Gaikwad is cramped for room and can only defend towards cover
Slower short of a length ball around hip high. He mistimes his pull towards deep square leg. Can get only a run for his effort
Similar length ball just outside off, he tries to beat backward point again with that nudge but fails to do so
Length ball just outside off, he plays with an open face of the bat to backward point
Oh, shot Sir! Was a back of a length ball just outside off. He swivels and sends the ball miles over deep midwicket. Some strike that

Little bit of miscommunication but Rahane is home eventually. Was a length ball outside off, he laces the drive to the right of mid-off and sets off. Only Gaikwad was not going anywhere. Rahane has to scurry back.
Fuller angling back into Gaikwad who drives on the up but straight to mid-off
Play and a miss once more. Was a good length ball outside off. He went across feeling for it, and is lucky to not get an edge on that
Length ball well outside off, Rahane was looking for a drive, instead gets it off the thickish outside half of his bat to deep third
Almost gets another one! Length ball on off, he looks to turn it away, closes the face of the bat early and gets a leading edge. The ball just evades Bhuvneshwar
Length on off stump, he gets across and defends staunchly

Bhuvneshwar Kumar has a first wicket in IPL 2024! He will be a relieved man. Was a back of a length ball outside off. He looks to go down the ground but the ball gets big on him. He ends up slicing it straight up and mid-on settles under it comfortably
Good length ball outside off, he stays still and thrashes the cut past backward point. The outfield is the batter's friend.

Direct hit and Ravindra was gone for all money. Cummins misses and Rachin will fight to live another day. He had given up. Length on off, he times it crisply to mid-on and sets off. Would have been comfortably short.
SWATTED! Good length ball on middle stump. He stays still and whacks it to the vacant deep midwicket region
Similar length ball outside off, he again opens the face of the bat and this time gets it past backward point
Good length ball angling away from Gaikwad who opens his face of the bat but can't beat backward point
Fuller in length with a hint of shape into the batter who flicks it neatly to deep square leg and some excellent running get them two
Length ball outside off, he plays with an open face of the blade down to deep third
ooh, play and a miss! On a length just outside off with a hint of nibble away from the batter. He has a poke at it and gets beaten.
On a length on middle and leg, ticked towards midwicket

Lovely placement and he gets four. Just a nice prod forward, nothing more. On a length outside off, he pushes at it and the ball bounces over backward point's head and races away. It was just a defensive prods, more. Example of excellent timing.
Length on middle and leg, he stays leg side of the ball and pushes to mid-off for a quick single.
Length ball to start off on leg stump. He flicks uppishly and on the bounce to midwicket
Gaikwad backs away and gives himself a little bit of room but Abhishek follows him with a flatter arm ball. He can only push back to the bowler
97.1kph length ball on the stumps, he goes back and punches to long-on
Flatter on off, he stays back and pushes to the bowler
BANG! Fuller down leg, he tries the seam-up ball but the line is down leg, he sweeps it hard and into the deep square leg fence
Arm ball swinging back into Gaikwad who wrists it to deep midwicket with soft hands
Shorter in length outside off, he stays back and whisks it away to deep midwicket
Reddy hits the winning runs in style! Slower one, full on middle, he manages to get under it and lofts it straight back over the sightscreen. A six-wicket win for SRH at their home
Clubbed back and dropped. Very full and just outside off, Klaasen powers it back. Too quick for Deshpande to hold on to in his follow-through
Short and slow, mistimes the pull and it works it his favour. Manages to run two
KLubbed! Length ball outside off, Klaasen transfers his weight back and lofts it over extra cover
Oopsy! Slower one well wide outside off, Klaasen is foxed. It lands short of Dhoni again. A bad bounce for him and it turned past him. Deep third does well to get around and prevent the boundary
Short and outside off, cracked away to deep midwicket
Full on off, driven back
Fuller on middle, knocked down to long-off
Length ball outside off, slapped through cover
Turned away through the on side
Switch-hit connected! Tossed up full on off, he quickly changes stands and hits it through the vacant third region
Slower through the air, full on off, he is unsure of coming forward or going back and pushes it to point
Quicker and outside off, cut to deep point
Turning in from a length, he goes back and works it away to wide long-on
Spinning in from outside off, goes back and slaps it through cover-point to get off the mark

Moeen and Dhoni appeal for lbw. You could almost not hear it. And next scene, they signal for DRS. Tossed up full on middle and leg, Shahbaz goes for the reverse sweep. Looks to have missed it. Did it pitch in line? Did it miss the bat? Replays taking time to load. No bat involved. And three reds again! Moeen strikes twice in two overs. Shahbaz looked unusually jittery this over
Connects and connects well! Moeen lands it on a length on off, this time Shahbaz does not back away. Stands still, frees his arms and ends the boundary drought by hitting it over long-on
Slows it up, loops it up outside off, he backs away and looks to go hard but completely misses the line
Flatter on middle and leg, reverse swept to backward point
Very full on off, dug out back towards the bowler. Just three from the over
Hoick and a miss! Klaasen looks to send it soaring over deep midwicket but only makes contact with thin air
Knocked to deep midwicket
Fuller on off, eased down to long-off to get going
Around the wicket, quicker and fuller on off, eased back towards the bowler
Tossed up outside off, driven to wide long-off

LBW appeal, given! Markram looks at the non-striker, who immediately asks him to go for the review. Has that turned a bit too much? Moeen tosses it up and lands it on a length outside off, Markram goes for the reverse sweep but misses because of the spin. Three reds and huge cheers in Hyderabad. Should make the list of soft dismissals for Markram, having looked at complete ease upto this point
Fuller around off, driven through wide mid-off
Tossed up, Shahbaz charges down and lofts it inside out for a couple more
Flatter and quicker on middle, clipped through square leg for a couple
Goes back to turn it through midwicket to bring up his fifty
Spinning ini from off, worked away through midwicket for two
Spinning down leg, Markram misses the flick but almost overbalances
Fuller and outside off, slapped to deep cover-point
Darts it in on a length just outside off, he gets a bottom edge towards short third
Quicker but on a length outside off, allows him to open the face and slap it wide of backward point
Backs away and punches this to long-off
On a length in line of the stumps, knocked down to long-off
Quicker and fuller on off, punched back to the bowler
Now goes back and punches one straight to long-off
Superb work from Rizvi in the deep. Sprints to his left from long-off and dives to save two. Markram went deep to slap a slowish offspin through the off side
Now Shahbaz chips it through the vacant mid-off region
Turning in from a length outside off, punches it back aerially. Lands short of Moeen and he deflects it towards long-off
Fuller on middle and leg, swept through backward square leg
Lands it on a length around off and gets it to turn away. Shahbaz keeps it out towards point
Flatter and outside off, goes deep in the crease and cuts it through backward point for a brace
Quicker and on a length on middle, glides it towards short third for a quick one
Tossed up full on middle and leg, slog-swept to midwicket
Turned straight to midwicket
Fuller on off, eased to long-off
Tossed up, he looks to slog it away but gets an inside edge onto his pad and to the on side

Shahbaz misses a low full toss. Huge appeal for lbw and Theekshana wants the review. Gets his wish. Looks like it hit Shahbaz on the full, on the boot in fact. So no question of pitching but the impact is umpire's call. CSK don't lose the review
Flatter on middle, 93.9kph, kept out towards midwicket

Ravindra almost messes it up! It was coming straight to him but he fumbled and managed to keep it in in the second attempt. And Head CANNOT believe what he has done - found the fielder perfectly. Theekshana tossed it up outside leg, the offspinner, the hit-me ball. Head obliged but not in the desired manner
Flatter and on a length outside off, 98.7kph, slapped straight to Gaikwad at cover
Quicker and on a length outside off, punched to deep cover-point
Glorious! Floated full around off, Markram makes room, clears his frontleg and powers it through covers
Angling in on the pads, clipped to deep midwicket
Slows it down on off and middle, Markram goes back and punches it to wide long-off, where Ravindra over-runs it and concedes a second
MASSIVE! Markram properly gets under that. Fired in on a length, 100.7kph, he deposits it over long-on
Edged but towards short third. Jadeja darts it full on off, Markram goes back to slap
Flatter and angling away, punched away to sweeper cover
Tosses it up full on off, he goes for the off drive but gets it off the inner half past the non-striker
Carrom ball on a length outside off, easy choice to go back and slap it through point
On a length, eased away to long-on off the front foot
Fuller on off, Head goes back and slices it through backward point. Hares back at two even as Dhoni deflects a flat throw onto the stumps
Slower and on a length, spinning in, goes back and clips it to deep midwicket
Carrom ball, quicker and fuller, punched to cover
Full on the stumps, goes back and punches it all along the ground to long-off
Length all again, punched to cover. First over without a boundary
Goes deep in the crease to the length ball and opens the face as he cuts it. Gets it away from point running to his left and gets two
Darts it into the surface on a length, he goes back and cuts it to deep point
Markram goes back and punches it to long-off
Goes back to the inspinning length ball and punches it to long-off
Starts with a length ball, cut to deep point
Slower one, full on middle and leg, pushes it with soft hands towards mid-on for a quick single, 118.6kph
Markram joins the party now. Backs away early, Deshpande follows him with a length ball that angles into him but lands around leg. He whips it through midwicket
Back of a length slower one, Head goes back and misses his waft. Lands short of Dhoni, who fails to collect it and it rolls away towards short third
In the slot, out of the spot! Full and just outside off, he clears the front leg and lofts it well over mid-off
Length ball angling away, slapped powerfully to cover, where Rizvi makes a half-stop
Starts off with a slower one but gets thumped. Offcutter on a length, slants away after landing. Head clears his front leg and hits it wide of mid-off's left
Slower one, angling in on a length, mistimed through midwicket. Gets just one as Choudhary runs in quickly from the deep
Fuller on the pads, flicked straight to short fine leg. Missed out, he feels, and exults, "C'mon!"
Wlel fielded by short third. Back of a length, 128.7kph, Head backs away and glides it towards the off side, where Theekshana dives
Digs it in and slants it around off, Head goes for the hoick across the line but misses
Full and angling in on middle and leg, heaved away through midwicket for two more
Not the best of timings. Length ball at 117.5kph, Head makes room and heaves it between cover and mid-off
Freebie. Full toss on middle, Markram backs away to make room and thumps it between cover and extra cover. 11 off the over
Fuller on off, driven to cover

Top edge but well over the fielders. Theekshana spots Markram making the early move to the off side and fires it on middle and leg. He sweeps and gets it well over short fine leg. Chahar hares after it and keeps it to two
"Catch!" the call but it is in the gap. Dances down the track early and lofts it between mid-off and covers
Quicker and fuller on off and middle, he goes back and gets his bat down hurriedly to block with an open bat-face
Begins with a flatter length ball on middle, Head goes back and slaps it wide of mid-off
On a length outside off, mistimed towards cover. An over that started expensively ends well
Length ball outside off, 134.3kph, pushed to backward point

End of the Abhishek Sharma show! The loud roar may not indicate that this is a home game for SRH. And Chahar is pumped up. Should have had a wicket in the opening over, but does so after taking a battering. Bowls it on a length outside off, Abhishek goes for a lofted shot over cover but slices it off the outer half. Jadeja runs to his right from backward point takes it reverse-cupped with a dive. Chahar exults
Another short ball, put away again. Abhishek has gone 6, 6, 4, 6, 4 in his last five balls. Chahar digs it short around off, 116.5kph, Abhishek makes room and slaps it over cover
Into the stands again! Chahar goes short again, on leg, 135kph, Abhishek pulls it hard and over
Around the wicket, angles it in on a length on middle and leg, heaved away to deep backward square leg
Twenty seven of the over! Proper slot ball, outside off. Allows the width for Abhishek to free his arms. He does with a forward-stride and hits it over extra cover
Gift, gleefully accepted! Full toss just outside off, Abhishek gets under it and tonks it over long-off. Free hit? What's that?

Whipped away in some style. Flair, elegance and timing all aplenty. Choudhary bowls it full on the pads, 139.2kph, Abhishek flicks it well over deep midwicket. And the bowler has overstepped, to make matters worse for CSK
Length ball around off, he hits it on the up, straight to mid-off
Poor ball, superb shot. Choudhary digs it short but angles it down leg. Abhishek swivels and deposits it wayyyy over fine leg
Full length on middle and leg, driven to mid-on
Lovely shot. Full and swinging away, but on off. Abhishek takes account of that and lifts it straight over the non-striker

Into the crowd! Ahead of the game, Chahar spoke about how the two-bouncer rule has helped bowlers in the middle overs more than in the powerplay. But he attempts another bumper in his first over. Pays the price. It was at 128.8kph, Head hops and cuts it well over deep point
Lands it on a length, swinging away, he pats it towards cover with soft hands and gets to the other end
Banged short on the stumps, 131.2kph, he thinks of pulling before leaving it be. Dhoni jumps and collects that
Outside off, swinging away, slapped to deep point

Edged and gone down! How many times has Head been dropped early in his innings! Chahar is not happy. A perfect plan, outswinger following one that moved in previous ball. Head slashes hard at that and it goes to slip. Moeen is perhaps done in by the quicker pace with which it came to him, and grasses it after going reverse-cupped
Swings it in from outside off, from a fuller length, Chahar. Head gets nicely forward and drives it to cover
